item.title: A Relaxing Autumn Drive
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: A cozy driving game made using Godot in 3 days. I tried using Blender’s geometry nodes for the environment, but misunderstood the exporting process, resulting in very poor performance.

item.title: Petals in the Wind
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: A system-based minigame made solo using Godot in 3 days about growing flowers to score points. It has problems with font scaling, but the core data-based programming architecture worked well.
